folds.heading: ## Rerun-packet reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B171)
folds.body:
The complete correction, freshness/tooling prework, original A1–A5 and O1–O5 were read. This is a historical rerun packet, not an instruction to create another chat or redo its work now. The independently reviewed later UI core rounds and MOCKUP owner retain the native-character follow-through and original reduced-shell correction. Signal/Folio and journal metaphors remain proposal sketches unless the actual adoption owner says otherwise; an unchanged hash cannot turn them into faithful native comparisons.

Keep baseline, populated native shell, interaction paths and full renderer/style/fixture/output identities separate from sketch freshness. A runnable study can still lack a representative journey, and a screenshot does not prove motion, reduced settings, focus or installed behavior. Current desktop/prose-first direction and independent-pane/task composition qualify old treatment recommendations. Optional decoration needs no invented gameplay reward, while claimed outcomes need actual native consumers. Old ownership/thread/port/tooling states are not present reservations or dispatch permission. No original source capture, prototype, user save or browser was opened during this content review.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B171)
folds.body:
All F1–F9/E1–E5, P1–P5/C1–C2 and L1–L4 were read. Preserve the refinements under existing meaning/knowledge/settlement owners: per-hit versus per-landed-hit denominator, item contribution versus worn result, apparent zero versus tiny nonzero, applied versus remaining duration, accepted job terms versus current definitions, and observed manifestation versus uncertain cause. Shared text must retain its subject and tense. Linear labels/units/comparison direction need actual accessibility inspection; keyboard reachability alone is not spoken comprehension. Numeric deltas/counts/links can reveal a hidden state even if its name is filtered.

These remain scoped proposals and applications, not automatic new UR codes or a universal glossary, precision or narration subsystem. Current UR70–75 already names meaning, actual behavior, units/clocks, attempts/output and shared inspection/history baselines; those live rows govern. UR76–UR82 retain their separate proposal/default status. A synthetic formatter edge is not necessarily reachable by a native item, and contextual calculation belongs to its consumer rather than a display-side evaluator. Historical Factorio/Diablo/Xbox examples are attributed precedent, not newly consulted pages, current game formulas or proof of OOPS narration. No new defect reproduction, full description census, source-wide rewrite or UI/accessibility test was performed.

folds.heading: ## Runtime-log sample reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B171)
folds.body:
The complete [UI log capture](../reviews/UI_LOG_CAPTURE_2026-11-03.md), this owner’s F15–F20 application and selected header/reference context were read. Keep its50 lines/three headless routes as a bounded text sample: zero CPY1 words in sampled visible line bodies does not mean the whole game or every tooltip is free of developer wording. Five sampled tooltips contain the date explanation; the report’s displayed example is one distinct repeated text. Twelve undefined-kind messages still exist as text even though kind filters cannot sort them. Existing adjacent keyed repeat folding was observed, so L4 is a refinement, not a missing folding engine.

The9 readable-subject/verb tense classifications are a subset of50, not the grammar distribution of all lines. Navigation chatter, duplicated craft receipts and mixed voice retain F16–F20 as concrete leads at their current producers. Existing owner dispositions already route them; this does not create a duplicate queue or endorse all CPY rules. Current UR70–74/RPT and Nov4 prose direction govern: use meaningful state, task voice, fitting whimsy and truthful historical outcomes, not a target percentage of second-person wording or punctuation. Old already-saved observations keep their original text unless an explicit scoped repair is chosen. No layout, current-runtime freshness, screen-reader or whole-log census claim follows; the full copy-sheet body remains independently reviewable.
